name: EPIC 248590462

text.card: A red giant 2,353 parsecs away, 10 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 14, give 1.04 solar masses and 10.3 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,793 K at its surface.
